notes.title: Big Performance Update
notes.notes:
- big performance improvements
- general grafic updates
- implemented different mesh LOD levels 
- reworked collision and optic of level 1
- fixed a bug where the game crashed while loading level 4
- some minor bugfixes

notes.title: Rayon Riddles Release Date
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that [b][i]Rayon Riddles - Rise of the Goblin King[/i][/b] will be released on Friday, November 11th. Just two more days to wait and then all of you can help Tech, Heavy, King and Tiny to escape from the orcs.

[b][u]Edit:[/u] Unfortunately we had to postpone the release a week, on November 11th.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26009265/e06ef323c39d89fc95d2aa2c23d815c77c963243.jpg[/img]
